raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "26.2.1"

recipe:
  name: mesalib
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://archive.mesa3d.org/mesa-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: c47e81bddc4760360a41ac3c5acec38acb81f9d750ecef47e7f3adc7021a4442
  patches:
    - if: win
      then:
        - patches/0001-Add-inteljitevents-module.patch
    # https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/work_items/16136
    - patches/0002-anv-i915-expose-a-cached-coherent-memory-type-where-t.patch

build:
  number: 2

outputs:
  - package:
      name: mesa-libgallium
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # On Windows the GL build produces opengl32.dll / libgallium_wgl.dll
      # instead of a lib/dri tree, and macOS builds no GL at all, so there is
      # nothing to split out on either.
      skip:
        - osx
        - win
      script: build_libgallium
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - flex
        - bison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - expat
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - libdrm
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        # The Intel and Nouveau gallium drivers compile their internal OpenCL C
        # kernels with mesa-clc at build time, which needs clang and the
        # SPIR-V/LLVM translator.  Neither is a runtime dependency.
        - clangdev
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
        - libxcb
        - xorg-libx11
        - xorg-libxext
        - xorg-libxxf86vm
        - xorg-xorgproto
        - xorg-libxrandr
        - xorg-libxshmfence
        - libglvnd-devel
        - libegl-devel
        - libglx-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          # The shared runtime every gallium driver needs.
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgbm.so.1
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libGLX_mesa.so.0
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libEGL_mesa${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/dri/libdril_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/gbm/dri_gbm${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/glvnd/egl_vendor.d/50_mesa.json
          - pkg-config --exists gbm
          # ... and not a single driver registered.
          - test -z "$(find $PREFIX/lib/dri -type l -name '*_dri.so')"
          - test ! -d $PREFIX/share/vulkan
          # None of the vendored DirectX-Headers subproject leaked into the
          # package -- those files belong to directx-headers.
          - test ! -e $PREFIX/include/directx/d3d12.h
          - test ! -e $PREFIX/include/dxguids/dxguids.h
          - test ! -e $PREFIX/lib/libDirectX-Guids.a
          - test ! -e $PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/DirectX-Headers.pc

  - package:
      name: mesa-llvmpipe
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # software rasterizer (LLVM JIT)
      skip:
        - osx
      script:
        - if: win
          then: build_llvmpipe
          else: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      build:
        # On Linux this is two symlinks next to the loader stub that
        # mesa-libgallium already installed, so it needs no toolchain.  Windows
        # selects its gallium driver at runtime rather than by filename (see
        # src/gallium/targets/wgl/wgl.c), so nothing can be split out there and
        # this output stays the whole WGL build.
        - if: win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - meson
            - pyyaml
            - mako
            - packaging
            - winflexbison
            - pkg-config
            - glslang
      host:
        - if: linux
          then:
            - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
        - if: win
          then:
            - zlib
            - zstd
            - spirv-tools
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - libxml2-devel
      run:
        - if: linux
          then:
            - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-llvmpipe', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: linux
            then:
              - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/swrast_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/kms_swrast_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\opengl32.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\libgallium_wgl.dll exit 1

  - package:
      name: mesa-iris
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # Intel Gen8+
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-iris', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/iris_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-crocus
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # Intel Gen4-7
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-crocus', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/crocus_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-i915
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # Intel Gen2-3
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-i915', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/i915_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-nouveau
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # NVIDIA, open
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-nouveau', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/nouveau_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-r300
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # AMD R300-R500
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-r300', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/r300_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-r600
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # AMD R600-Evergreen
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-r600', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/r600_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-svga
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # VMware guest
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:

      run:

      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-svga', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/vmwgfx_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-d3d12
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # D3D12, i.e. WSL
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-d3d12', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/d3d12_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-virgl
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # virtio-gpu guest
      skip:
        - osx
        - win
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:

      run_exports:

          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-zink
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # OpenGL on top of Vulkan
      skip:
        - osx
        - win
      script: build_dri_links
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-libgallium', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-zink', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:

          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/vkms_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesa-lavapipe
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # software rasterizer (LLVM JIT)
      script: build_vulkan
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - if: unix
          then:
            - flex
            - bison
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - if: linux
              then: libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - expat
        # libdrm is the userspace wrapper around the Linux kernel's DRM
        # ioctls and has no macOS build.  lavapipe is a pure software
        # rasterizer, so mesa only asks for libdrm via the linux winsys.
        - if: linux
          then: libdrm
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - clangdev
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libxcb
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - xorg-libxrandr
            - xorg-libxshmfence
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-lavapipe', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_lvp${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f $PREFIX/share/drirc.d/00-lavapipe-defaults.conf
              - if: x86_64
                then: test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json
              - if: aarch64
                then: test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.aarch64.json
              - if: ppc64le
                then: test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.ppc64le.json
              # lavapipe alone, no second ICD riding along
              - test 1 -eq "$(ls $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/ | wc -l)"
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\vulkan_lvp.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\vulkan\icd.d\lvp_icd.x86_64.json exit 1
              # dzn lives in mesa-dzn now, and DirectX-Headers is not vendored
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\vulkan_dzn.dll exit 1
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\directx\d3d12.h exit 1

  - package:
      name: mesa-anv
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # Intel Gen8+
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_vulkan
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - if: unix
          then:
            - flex
            - bison
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - if: linux
              then: libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - expat
        - if: linux
          then: libdrm
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - clangdev
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libxcb
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - xorg-libxrandr
            - xorg-libxshmfence
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
            - directx-headers
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-anv', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_intel${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/intel_icd.x86_64.json
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/drirc.d/00-anv-defaults.conf

  - package:
      name: mesa-hasvk
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # Intel Gen8-9 (legacy)
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_vulkan
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - if: unix
          then:
            - flex
            - bison
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - if: linux
              then: libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - expat
        - if: linux
          then: libdrm
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - clangdev
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libxcb
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - xorg-libxrandr
            - xorg-libxshmfence
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
            - directx-headers
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-hasvk', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_intel_hasvk${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/intel_hasvk_icd.x86_64.json
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/drirc.d/00-hasvk-defaults.conf

  - package:
      name: mesa-venus
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # virtio-gpu guest
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
      script: build_vulkan
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - if: unix
          then:
            - flex
            - bison
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - if: linux
              then: libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - expat
        - if: linux
          then: libdrm
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - clangdev
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libxcb
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - xorg-libxrandr
            - xorg-libxshmfence
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
            - directx-headers
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-venus', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_virtio${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/virtio_icd.x86_64.json
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/drirc.d/00-venus-defaults.conf

  - package:
      name: mesa-dzn
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # Vulkan on top of D3D12 -- hardware-backed, so not part of mesalib
      skip:
        - not win
      script: build_vulkan
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - if: unix
          then:
            - flex
            - bison
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - if: linux
              then: libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - expat
        - if: linux
          then: libdrm
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - clangdev
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libxcb
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - xorg-libxrandr
            - xorg-libxshmfence
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
            - directx-headers
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-dzn', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\vulkan_dzn.dll exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\vulkan\icd.d\dzn_icd.x86_64.json exit 1
          - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\vulkan_lvp.dll exit 1
          - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\directx\d3d12.h exit 1

  - package:
      name: mesa-kosmickrisp
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # Vulkan on top of Metal -- hardware-backed, so not part of mesalib
      skip:
        - not (osx and arm64)
      script: build_vulkan
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - flex
        - bison
        - pkg-config
        - glslang
      host:
        - expat
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - clangdev
        - libclc
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-kosmickrisp', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_kosmickrisp${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/kosmickrisp_mesa_icd.aarch64.json

  - package:
      name: mesa-intel
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      skip:
        - not (linux and x86_64)
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-iris', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-anv', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/iris_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_intel${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: mesalib
      version: ${{ version }}
    # mesalib means software rendering: llvmpipe for OpenGL, lavapipe for
    # Vulkan.  Everything else mesa builds is backed by real hardware --
    # iris/anv (Intel), dzn (D3D12), kosmickrisp (Metal) -- and is now
    # installed deliberately by name instead of arriving with mesalib.
    #
    # On macOS mesa builds no OpenGL at all, so mesalib is lavapipe alone.
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-lavapipe', exact=True) }}
        - if: not osx
          then:
            - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-llvmpipe', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesalib', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_lvp${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: linux
            then:
              - test -L $PREFIX/lib/dri/swrast_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libEGL_mesa${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\vulkan_lvp.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\opengl32.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\libgallium_wgl.dll exit 1
